summary: Stamp duty assessment on encumbered property; market value determination for lease/tenant-purchased property; rent capitalization vs actual transaction value; market value diminished by tenant possession and prior agreement; willing buyer-willing seller principle applied; concurrent findings on market rate upheld; penalty set aside by HC; interest under S.47-A(4A) challenged; Rs.1 cr deposit acknowledged.
legal_provisions_cited: U.P. Urban Buildings (Regulation of Letting, Rent and Eviction) Act 1972
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; deficit stamp duty revised downward; penalty and interest quashed; amount already deposited (Rs.1 cr) to be adjusted against revised duty.
